text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fatigue has gotten the better of Sakura Bakushin O, so I tell her to get some rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Rest is also one of the duties of a model student! Okay! Goodnight!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wh-where on earth am I?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wow! Look, look! It's Sakura Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: It's a chance to introduce ourselves! Class Rep! Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ooh?! Such a lovely greeting! Good morning, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Foreign Prime Minister
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O, your brilliance is well-known even in my homeland!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wow! You're that super important famous foreign prime minister that often appears on TV, right?!

text_block_list.name: Foreign King
text_block_list.text: You are so wonderful! All our citizens do Bakushins to follow in your footsteps!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh… Of course, Mr, Alien. After all, I…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I am indeed the model student of this world! The class representative of the Milky Way! Sakura Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: YEEAH! BAKUSHIN O! BAKUSHIN O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: All right, everyone! Righteousness! Justice! Bakushin, BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gasp! It was just a dream?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But to be a class representative idolized as a role model worldwide…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's definitely a vision of the future!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O wakes up in a great mood. It appears she got more than enough rest.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Prime Minister
text_block_list.text: …It's a shame, but there is another person better suited to being class representative than you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wha… What did you say?!

text_block_list.name: Foreign King
text_block_list.text: Indeed… they have my vote as well. I wish you luck in the next election.

text_block_list.name: Alien
text_block_list.text: ※×＠■〇～… Well, I guess that's that. See you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh, a dream?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Argh! I have to work even harder and become a better class representative!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, Sakura Bakushin O's tense dream prevents her from getting much rest.
